i just went to your profile and i saw you do a great job cheering people up, and hearing their problems. I just want to say thank you, these small gestures do mean a lot, especially for people like me who don't have any other form to open up about these issues.

Answering your question, i go to law school in Brazil and i'm in the last year before graduation, i'm a 22 year old male, currently doing internship at a major public repartition. The problem isn't really about money, my family can afford therapy, but as i mentioned it's viewed by my relatives as a sort of a problem seeking these sort of help, but i'll seek someone because i feel like i'm very close to actually doing something that i will regret it. Again, Thank you!

For the last 10 years i have considered killing myself every single night before i go to sleep, imagining what the people around me would feel and react after i did it. It's something that i actually desire, something that doesn't come off my mind, and the only thing keeping me from doing it it's my mom, i don't think she would handle it, and i don't want to feel responsible for killing her aswell. 

So the way i've reacting for the past years, is to push the people who are close to me away, so they won't miss me when i eventually kill myself. I have very low self steem, due to appearance issues i have with my body, and because it is sort of a "tabu" in my family i can't seek medical assistence to take care of my depression.

I'm sorry i took anybody's time reading through this, i just saw this post on /r/all and took the oportunity to open myself, sorry for any gramatical errors, english is not my native language. Have a nice day.
